metrics.name: Access Rule Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: AccessRules[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Name`, to_string(Name)]), join(`: `, [`Enabled`, to_string(Enabled)]), join(`: `, [`Action`, to_string(ConnectionsAre)]), join(`: `, [`Service`, to_string(Service)]), join(`: `, [`From`, to_string(FromAliasList)]), join(`: `, [`To`, to_string(ToAliasList)]), join(`: `, [`Static NAT`, to_string(StaticNat)]), join(`: `, [`Global NAT`, to_string(GlobalDnat)]) , join(`: `, [`Global 1:1 Nat`, to_string(Global_1to1Nat)])]) | sort(@)

metrics.name: Alias Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Aliases[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Name`, to_string("Alias Name")]), join(`: `, [`Description`, to_string(Description)]), join(`: `, [`Members`, to_string(AliasMembersList_r)])]) | sort(@)

metrics.name: Dynamic NAT Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: NAT.dynamicNAT[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`To`, to_string(To)]), join(`: `, [`From`, to_string(From)]), join(`: `, [`Source IP`, to_string(SourceIP)])]) | sort(@)

metrics.name: Features Expiring Within 30 Days Count
metrics.gotcha: DaysUntilExpiration_r is a resolved/computed string field — filter uses string comparison '<= 30' not numeric. Confirm behavior when value is exactly 30.
